privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Librishelf processes, why, and how you control it.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Account data: username, email and password. Your password is stored securely and nobody can read it, not even us.
Content you add: your books and their details (title, authors, publisher, ISBN, tags and dates) and the covers you upload.
Access data: the IP address of your visits is used briefly, only to protect the service from abuse such as repeated login attempts.

sections.title: How we use it
paragraphs: Only to run Librishelf: keep you signed in, store and show your library, and protect your account.
We do not sell or share your data with anyone, and we use no advertising or tracking tools.

sections.title: Public library
paragraphs: Your library is private by default. If you turn on sharing in Account, anyone with your link can see your books and covers, and some covers may appear on the site's sign-in pages.
You can turn it off whenever you want, and the change is immediate.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We use a single essential cookie that keeps you signed in. It is not used for tracking or advertising.
Your theme and language preferences are saved only in your browser.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: For as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, all your data is removed immediately.
Backups may keep this data for a limited period until they are replaced.

sections.title: Your rights (LGPD)
paragraphs: You can view, correct, request a copy of or delete your data at any time. You can make corrections and delete your account in the app itself; for other requests, reach us at the contact below.
